speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your hand tremors in detail: when do they occur, do they stop when you rest your hands, and how would you rate their severity? Also, when did you first notice the memory issues, and do you feel you are forgetting recent conversations or personal history?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Tremor is unlikely given the unilateral onset and progressive cognitive decline; the clinical picture of asymmetric rest/postural tremor with recent memory loss in a 70-year-old strongly suggests Parkinson's Disease with early dementia or Dementia with Lewy Bodies.
